items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I don't know nothing about him. I ain't never seen him.

ctx.x: Did he slap? Would he, he had slap bass? No, he got a good sound out of it.

Good sound. Good sound. No, no, no. When we made this record, that sound kind of funny. Because John Henry's brother. Mm-hmm. He played a lot of bass like he was slapping. Mm-hmm. He took a whole lot of solo there on the record, but you could hear that bass. Block, block, block, block. You know, it didn't sound boom, boom like that. Block, Block like a drum or something. Mm-hmm. And the drum we had was too loud. What was your drum? I don't know what it meant. I got it somewhere in there. I don't know nothing…
We can find out. Oh. Oh.
